title: PCG containing oil spill after vessel sinks off Surigao del Sur

blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY— The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has launched containment and cleanup operations for an oil spill triggered by the sinking of a landing craft tank off Carrascal, Surigao del Sur, on Tuesday. In a report, the PCG said Landing Craft Tank (LCT) 8 sank off Carrascal after strong winds and rough sea conditions battered the vessel. The PCG was alerted to the incident at around 5:22 a.m. when the vessel’s captain called to report that the ship had gone down and was leaking oil.
